title: Refuse a multi-line paste into the secret prompt: drain and flush, and point docs at the file or stdin route (DEC-255 (a2)(3))
description: DEC-255 (a2) clause (3), read by ref from opum-doc origin/dev .quest/planning.json (0a9c0480) on 2026-11-03, verbatim: "Multi-line paste (WCLI-97 follow-up): when input is still queued after the terminator, REFUSE with a plain error, then drain and flush, consistent with secret-value.ts's bound refusal; docs point multi-line secrets to the file or stdin route. A post-tag follow-up, not a flip gate." Filed only; not started. The leader runs the dispatch floor on this id and then briefs it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: When input is still queued after the terminator, the prompt refuses with a plain error, then drains and flushes the queued input, and no queued byte reaches a later prompt or the shell
The refusal is consistent with the bound refusal in secret-value.ts
The docs point multi-line secrets to the file or stdin route
